const [userStatusFilter, setUserStatusFilter] = useState('All'); const [sellerSearch, setSellerSearch] = useState(''); const [sellerStatusFilter, setSellerStatusFilter] = useState('All'); const [activityRoleFilter, setActivityRoleFilter] = useState('All'); const [activitySeverityFilter, setActivitySeverityFilter] = useState('All'); // Settings State const [settings, setSettings] = useState({ requireSellerApproval: true, emailVerification: true, autoSuspendOnFraud: false, realTimeFraudAlerts: true, maxWithdrawal: 15000, commissionRate: 8, }); // Data Collections const users = [ { id: 'USR-001', name: 'Priya Nair', email: 'priya@example.com', status: 'active', spent: '$1,240', lastActive: '2026-09-07', joined: '2025-03-14' }, { id: 'USR-002', name: 'James Okafor', email: 'james@example.com', status: 'active', spent: '$389', lastActive: '2026-09-08', joined: '2025-06-02' }, { id: 'USR-003', name: 'Sofia Merano', email: 'sofia@example.com', status: 'suspended', spent: '$56', lastActive: '2026-07-14', joined: '2024-11-20' }, { id: 'USR-004', name: 'Tariq Hassan', email: 'tariq@example.com', status: 'pending', spent: '$0', lastActive: '2026-09-05', joined: '2026-09-05' }, { id: 'USR-005', name: 'Mei Lin', email: 'mei@example.com', status: 'active', spent: '$3,780', lastActive: '2026-09-06', joined: '2025-01-08' }, ]; const sellers = [ { id: 'SEL-001', name: 'Aura Collective', email: 'aura@example.com', status: 'active', orders: 1482, revenue: '$84,200', joined: '2024-09-01' }, { id: 'SEL-002', name: 'Nova Goods', email: 'nova@example.com', status: 'active', orders: 674, revenue: '$31,540', joined: '2025-02-14' }, { id: 'SEL-003', name: 'Verdant Supply', email: 'verdant@example.com', status: 'suspended', orders: 103, revenue: '$4,820', joined: '2024-12-01' }, { id: 'SEL-004', name: 'Kite & Thread', email: 'kite@example.com', status: 'pending', orders: 0, revenue: '$0', joined: '2026-09-06' }, ]; const activityLogs = [ { id: 'ACT-1', actor: 'James Okafor', role: 'user', action: 'Placed order #ORD-9921', target: 'Aura Collective', time: '2 min ago', severity: 'info' }, { id: 'ACT-2', actor: 'Verdant Supply', role: 'seller', action: 'Attempted bulk price update (flagged)', target: '82 SKUs', time: '14 min ago', severity: 'warning' }, { id: 'ACT-3', actor: 'Sofia Merano', role: 'user', action: 'Triggered fraud alert — 5 failed payments', target: 'Checkout', time: '31 min ago', severity: 'critical' }, { id: 'ACT-4', actor: 'Aura Collective', role: 'seller', action: 'Listed 12 new products', target: 'Catalog', time: '1 hr ago', severity: 'info' }, { id: 'ACT-5', actor: 'Priya Nair', role: 'user', action: 'Submitted refund request #REF-441', target: 'ORD-8810', time: '2 hr ago', severity: 'info' }, { id: 'ACT-6', actor: 'Kite & Thread', role: 'seller', action: 'Registered seller account', target: 'Onboarding', time: '3 hr ago', severity: 'info' }, { id: 'ACT-7', actor: 'Mei Lin', role: 'user', action: 'Changed shipping address post-payment', target: 'ORD-9900', time: '5 hr ago', severity: 'warning' }, { id: 'ACT-8', actor: 'Nova Goods', role: 'seller', action: 'Withdrew $12,000 to bank', target: 'Wallet', time: '6 hr ago', severity: 'info' }, ]; // Filtering Logic const filteredUsers = users.filter(u => { const matchesFilter = userStatusFilter === 'All' || u.status === userStatusFilter.toLowerCase(); const matchesSearch = u.name.toLowerCase().includes(userSearch.toLowerCase()) || u.email.toLowerCase().includes(userSearch.toLowerCase()); return matchesFilter && matchesSearch; }); const filteredSellers = sellers.filter(s => { const matchesFilter = sellerStatusFilter === 'All' || s.status === sellerStatusFilter.toLowerCase(); const matchesSearch = s.name.toLowerCase().includes(sellerSearch.toLowerCase()) || s.email.toLowerCase().includes(sellerSearch.toLowerCase()); return matchesFilter && matchesSearch; }); const filteredLogs = activityLogs.filter(log => { const matchesRole = activityRoleFilter === 'All' || log.role === activityRoleFilter.toLowerCase(); const matchesSeverity = activitySeverityFilter === 'All' || log.severity === activitySeverityFilter.toLowerCase(); return matchesRole && matchesSeverity; }); return (
